name: GPS Almanac (NAVCEN SEM/YUMA) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls a public GPS almanac (USCG NAVCEN SEM/YUMA) over HTTP on a timer, maps each PRN's mean Keplerian elements to a schema-exact SDS OMM record (honestly labeled GPS-LNAV-ALMANAC, not SGP4), and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic GPS almanac pull (default every 12h; NAVCEN regenerates the current almanac ~daily at most — one small SEM/YUMA file, per-pull record churn bounded by objectCap).

methods.description: Fetches a public GPS almanac (NAVCEN SEM/YUMA, auto-detected) over HTTP, emits a schema-exact SDS OMM record per PRN, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each pulled + stored GPS almanac OMM record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull record.
